reuse.why: Extends the existing shared weekend helpers (getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getDayWithSkippedWeekend, skipsWeekendOccurrences) and routes the parsed schedule data through parseRecurDate, rather than adding parallel holiday logic.

duplication.why: Replaces every scattered d.isWeekend check with one isNonWorkingDay and the look-ahead sizing with one getDailyTakeCount; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The holiday rule lives in shared/schedules beside the weekend rule, and the server and template code only pass the list along.

scope.why: Covers the type, the shared rule, its callers and tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: One definition of a non-working day, but holidays is an optional trailing parameter that each caller has to remember to pass, and leaving it out fails silently.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay (used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange) with getDailyTakeCount for the look-ahead
